title: The Azure Snarewright's Great Canon
summary: A great canon of the azure snarewright that crowns its snares with a vast cage of soul force held until the user lets it fall.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Lattice Keepers
summary: A treatise on setting two lattices of soul force one above the other so no soul freed from the first escapes the second.

title: The Hawk-Eyed Gaoler's High Art
summary: A high art of watching one point without blinking and dropping a cage of soul force on whatever tries to slip from sight.

title: The Basin and River Binding Compendium
summary: A compendium on soul force gathered in a basin and loosed as a river that weighs on limbs and drowns will.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Reckoning of Traps
summary: A great reckoning of snares that ride the wind and close on a soul in the middle of a gust.

title: The Canon of the Open Sky Gin
summary: A canon of the open gin whose jaws stand wide in plain air and snap shut on any soul that comes within their bite.

title: Treatise of the Unbroken Net
summary: A treatise on nets of soul force whose strands hold against every strain and whose weave seals a caught soul's techniques.

title: The Long Bearing Snare Compendium
summary: A compendium of snares laid far out along a true bearing that close on souls well beyond ordinary reach.
